behavior: `Combobox.Input` and `Autocomplete.Input` keep the caret keys of the browser when they render an element that is not an `<input>`, such as a `<textarea>`. While the popup is closed, ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the caret between the lines and do not open the popup. Such an element has no `role="combobox"` while the popup is closed, as in Base UI. While the popup is open, the two keys move the highlight. Home and End go to the browser in each state. Base UI opens the popup for ArrowDown and ArrowUp, and it moves the caret to the start or the end of the whole text for Home and End.
